response.sql:
WITH per_circuit AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.date BETWEEN '1978-03-04' AND '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_count) AS avg_count
  FROM per_circuit
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT p.circuitId, p.country, p.race_count, p.race_count / a.avg_count AS ratio
FROM per_circuit p
JOIN country_avg a ON a.country IS p.country
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The `date` column stores ISO-format YYYY-MM-DD text, so a plain text BETWEEN is a correct inclusive date range as the request specifies.

Only circuits with at least one race in the date window are included in the per-country averages. Circuits with zero races in the window do not appear in the join, so they do not pull the average down.
Countries are grouped with IS so that a NULL country is treated as its own group; the ratio is never NULL because every group has an average of at least 1.
